title: Diffusion-Driven State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.21036v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In many domains, practitioners seek models that produce accurate forecasts while faithfully capturing latent system dynamics. Existing approaches typically sacrifice one of these goals: deep state space models often assume Gaussian latent transitions, limiting fit and forecasting, while diffusion models are highly expressive but lack principled inference for the underlying dynamics. To combine the strengths of both, we introduce the Diffusion-Driven State Space Model (DDSSM), which replaces the conventional Gaussian transition distribution with a diffusion model. Our DDSSM resolves the open problem of how to jointly train an autoencoder and a diffusion model on sequential data, thereby extending the literature on latent diffusion models for time series. Moreover, we find that the DDSSM empirically outperforms a state-of-the-art deep SSM at fitting and forecasting a simulated time series with multimodal transitions.

translated_title: 扩散驱动的状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 在许多领域中，从业者希望模型既能产生准确的预测，又能忠实地捕捉潜在的系统动态。现有方法通常会牺牲其中一个目标：深度状态空间模型往往假设潜变量转移服从高斯分布，从而限制了拟合与预测能力，而扩散模型虽然具有很强的表达能力，却缺乏对底层动态的原则性推断。为了结合两者的优势，我们提出了扩散驱动的状态空间模型（DDSSM），它用扩散模型替代了传统的高斯转移分布。我们的DDSSM解决了如何在序列数据上联合训练自编码器和扩散模型这一开放性问题，从而拓展了面向时间序列的潜扩散模型相关文献。此外，我们发现DDSSM在拟合与预测具有多峰转移的模拟时间序列时，实证表现优于最先进的深度状态空间模型。
tldr: 本文提出扩散驱动的状态空间模型（DDSSM），以扩散模型替代传统高斯转移分布，解决了在序列数据上联合训练自编码器与扩散模型的开放问题，并在多峰转移时间序列的拟合与预测上超越现有最先进的深度状态空间模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Diffusion-Driven State Space Model (DDSSM), which replaces the conventional Gaussian transition distribution with a diffusion model, resolves the open problem of jointly training an autoencoder and a diffusion model on sequential data, and empirically outperforms state-of-the-art deep SSMs in fitting and forecasting time series with multimodal transitions.
